Marathon Trading Investment Management Lowered Stake in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) by $3.76 Million; South Texas Money Management LTD Has Lifted Occidental Petroleum (OXY) Holding by $1.25 Million
May 13, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Bruce J. Richards decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 43.09% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Marathon Trading Investment Management Llc sold 21,884 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Bruce J. Richards held 28,905 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.98M, down from 50,789 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marathon Trading Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $499.40 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.82% or $1.6 during the last trading session, reaching $194.36. About 12.74M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
South Texas Money Management Ltd increased its stake in Occidental Petroleum (OXY) by 3.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. South Texas Money Management Ltd bought 17,109 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 510,677 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $37.62 million, up from 493,568 at the end of the previous reported quarter. South Texas Money Management Ltd who had been investing in Occidental Petroleum for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $65.07 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.32% or $1.11 during the last trading session, reaching $84.97. About 6.62M shares traded or 15.60% up from the average. Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) has risen 4.69% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.86% the S&P500.
Among 39 analysts covering Alibaba ( NYSE:BABA ), 37 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 95% are positive. Alibaba had 177 analyst reports since August 12, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating by Needham given on Friday, August 18. Morgan Stanley maintained Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) rating on Wednesday, October 28. Morgan Stanley has “Overweight” rating and $101 target. Morgan Stanley reinitiated Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) rating on Thursday, December 8. Morgan Stanley has “Overweight” rating and $130 target. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, November 3 by Needham. The stock of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has “Buy” rating given on Monday, June 26 by Oppenheimer. The stock of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) earned “Buy” rating by Bank of America on Thursday, September 7. As per Friday, August 14, the company rating was maintained by TH Capital. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, August 17 by Bank of America. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Tuesday, August 22 by Atlantic Securities. The stock has “Outperform” rating by Credit Suisse on Friday, August 12.
Marathon Trading Investment Management Llc, which manages about $886.83M and $3.59B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Vaneck Vectors Etf Tr by 101,033 shares to 137,133 shares, valued at $3.19M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Advanced Micro Devices Inc (NASDAQ:AMD) by 34,599 shares in the quarter, for a total of 53,599 shares, and has risen its stake in Select Sector Spdr Tr (XLE).

It also reduced its holding in Sysco Corp (NYSE:SYY) by 17,491 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 918,460 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
